quests.title: Salvage the buried lens
quests.description: Varakush has heard of a Relic Seeker's Lens half-buried in the Outskirts. Recover it.
quests.objective: Defeat any Aetheric creature and return.

stages.narration: Varakush slips a folded map into your hand — silt-stained at the corners. 'The lens is buried somewhere out there. Aetheric creatures guard the dig sites; cut your way through and bring back what you find.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter watches the map fold close. "The Order pays in books. Useful books."

stages.narration: A hum from somewhere south — the lens reading the air around you, even buried. Aetheric resistance grows the closer you draw to the dig site.
You unearth a crystalline disc the size of a saucer. Faint geometry visible through the silt — the Relic Seeker's Lens. Bring it back to a Forgotten Order agent.

quests.title: Field a scholar
quests.description: Travel to two new locations and bring back what you saw.

stages.narration: The scholar hands you a slim travel ledger and three sharpened pencils. 'Walk. Note. Return. The Order remembers what walkers tell us.'
You note the first place — wind direction, sky color, what you heard. The page fills more than you expected.
Second location, second entry. The ledger is starting to feel like something the Order will actually read.

quests.title: Run the haul
quests.description: The Guild needs 100 TC worth of relic salvage. Deliver, no questions asked.
quests.objective: Reach 100 TC, then complete the quest.

stages.narration: The Reclaimer hands you a delivery slip — blank line for what you bring, signed by the Guild's broker. 'Anything sellable. Don't ask. We don't.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter says nothing. The Guild prefers it that way.

stages.narration: Coin gathers in your pack faster than you expected. The broker's slip is half-filled.

quests.title: Pinch from the Monarchs
quests.description: Steal something from a Mud Monarchs vendor without being caught.

stages.narration: The Reclaimer's voice drops. 'A Mud Monarchs vendor. Anything they're not watching. Bring it back.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter's gaze sharpens. "The Monarchs remember faces. Cover yours."

stages.narration: You feel eyes on you wherever Monarch silver shows. The opportunity will come once.

quests.title: Walk the buried road
quests.description: Make a pilgrimage to a buried capital — every True Tartarian who matters has done it.

stages.narration: The elder traces a finger across an old map. 'The road goes where the ground forgets it. Walk it. We will know.'
Your boots find the first stretch of buried road — the silt is firmer here, packed by the dead before you.
Half-way. The wind off the buried capital smells like rust and old incense.
The towers rise out of the mud-flats — not all the way, but enough to call it a city. You have walked the road. Return to any True Tartarian agent.

quests.title: Cut down a rare beast
quests.description: The enclave hears you. Prove you fight like one of them.
quests.objective: Defeat a Rare or Legendary enemy.

stages.narration: The Giant elder hands you a stone token. 'When you take down something Rare or worse, bring the token back. We will know what to do with it.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter notes the weight of the token. "A small thing the Giants take seriously."

stages.narration: The token warms in your pack — the elder's mark hums when there's a Rare creature in range. Hunt accordingly.

quests.title: Silence a rediscoverer
quests.description: Someone has been talking about Tartaria where they should not. End the conversation.

stages.narration: The Monarch agent's voice is flat. 'Three names. Three silences. You don't have to know why. We do.'
stages.arbiter: The Arbiter's eyes go cold. "The Monarchs name the silenced. We do not."

stages.narration: One down. The agent's network confirms — a name struck from somewhere you'll never see.
Two. The work goes faster than feels comfortable.
Three. Return to any Monarch agent for the seal.
